Sophia G.: Heads up — ArdentAI invoice INV-2026-033 (USD 47,980) hit an ACH return this morning. Customer emailed saying cashflow tight, asking to split over 3 payments. Dunning status: attempted email + phone. Any objections to offering a 3-month installment with a $500 late fee?
Rob (Finance): What was the bank return code? If it's R01 (NSF) we can offer retry and a card fallback. Need to confirm whether this is a one-off.
billing-bot: Payment attempt failed: ACH returned R01 (Insufficient Funds) — attempted at 2026-03-23T09:12Z
Liam - Support: CS has been on calls — they say COO verbally approved splitting but wants written plan. They also asked that service not be interrupted during the plan if first payment posts.
Elaine (CSM): CSM note: renewal in 45 days. Prefer to avoid cutting access; propose reduced quota while plan is active.
Rob (Finance): I'm ok with 3 installments but need card auth for the first one or a cleared ACH. Proposal: $20,000 now, $13,990 in 30 days, $13,990 in 60 days. Add a $500 one-time late fee. Require signed payment plan email + cc of billing contact.
Sophia G.: Can we try card on file? Their token expired last month. Liam, can you get card auth today? If not, we attempt ACH retry in 48h and concurrently send the payment plan for signature.
Liam - Support: I'll reach out now. Draft payment plan email below — please review and edit: 
```
Subject: Payment plan for INV-2026-033 (ArdentAI)
Hi {{CFO name}},
Thanks for the call earlier. Per our agreement, Redwood Inference is prepared to accept the following payment schedule to bring account current: 
1) $20,000 due immediately (card authorization or cleared ACH)
2) $13,990 due in 30 days
3) $13,990 due in 60 days
A one-time $500 late fee will be applied to the account. Services will remain at reduced quota until the second payment clears. Please reply to this email with “I agree” and a signature to confirm.
Best,
Liam on behalf of Redwood Billing
```
Elaine (CSM): LGTM. Add clause: services only restricted after two missed payments. Otherwise agree.
Rob (Finance): Also add our reconciliation tag: AR_RECOV_ARDENTAI_2026. Finance will mark the AR and hold for collections if first payment fails.
Sophia G.: If we don't get a signed confirmation by EOD Friday escalate to legal. Flagging for follow-up.
billing-bot: Dunning email scheduled: Reminder 2 — 2026-03-24T15:00Z
Liam - Support: Update — CFO replied: "can do card today" and requested the payment link. Sending tokenization request to payments team now.
Sophia G.: Great — once card is charged, please attach the auth receipt and signed email to the ticket and move to "Payment Plan — Active". cc Rob (Finance). Thanks everyone.
